summary: Comprehensive architectural blueprint and implementation plan for the Network Relationship Canvas (NRC) subsystem in NetSentinel. Covers core visual intent philosophy, database schema with first-class relationships, agent daemon architecture, firewall translation providers (Windows, nftables, iptables, ufw, pf, pfSense/OPNsense), interactive canvas engine with SVG/HTML5 zoom/pan/edge routing, compliance engine, real-time traffic animation, AI natural language policy generation, sequence diagrams, and phased implementation roadmap.
